name: sports-betting-intel
title: Pry Sports Betting Intelligence
description: Comprehensive sports betting intelligence: live odds across 112+ books, arbitrage detection, +EV opportunities, player props, live in-game analytics, sharp money tracking (steam moves, RLM, bet/money divergence), weather impact, lineup data, prediction market cross-reference, Kelly criterion stake sizing, and futures odds. The most complete sports betting data actor on Apify.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Sports Betting Intelligence
input.description: Comprehensive sports betting intelligence: live odds across 112+ books, arbitrage detection, +EV opportunities, player props, live in-game analytics, sharp money tracking, weather impact, lineup data, prediction market cross-reference, Kelly criterion stake sizing, and futures odds.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process (ESPN / odds API endpoints to scrape).

report_type.title: Report Type
report_type.description: Which intelligence report to generate: full (everything), odds_only, sharp_only, props_only, live_only, or weather_only.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport filter: all, nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, soccer, mma, tennis, or any supported league key.

include_prediction_markets.title: Include Prediction Markets
include_prediction_markets.description: Cross-reference sportsbook odds against prediction market prices (Polymarket/Kalshi style venues).

include_weather.title: Include Weather Impact
include_weather.description: Attach weather conditions and betting-impact assessment for outdoor events.

include_sharp_intel.title: Include Sharp Money Intelligence
include_sharp_intel.description: Track steam moves, reverse line movement (RLM), and bet/money percentage divergence.

include_kelly.title: Include Kelly Criterion Sizing
include_kelly.description: Compute fractional Kelly stake sizing for detected +EV opportunities.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
